spec_features.feature_name: small default scale + acknowledgement-gated full scale
spec_features.spec_quote: welfare.scale defaults to 0.02 (2% smoke scale). Full-scale runs require --i-understand-welfare
spec_features.evidence: config/default.yaml:209 scale: 0.02; cli.py:36 adds --i-understand-welfare, cli.py:80 passes acknowledged=args.i_understand_welfare into WelfareGuard.from_config; check_run (welfare.py:78-85) raises PermissionError if scale>=0.5 and require_ack_for_full_run and not acknowledged. The 0.02 default propagates through scaled_count to actual loop bounds.
spec_features.notes: Default 0.02 effectively shrinks every run; full-scale (>=0.5) is blocked without the flag. Note the threshold for the gate is 0.5, not full scale, but it is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "The default `welfare.scale` is small (a smoke test), so simply running the code does not generate thousands of distressed rollouts." (welfare.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: WelfareGuard.check_run gates every elicitation entry point and prints a banner
spec_features.evidence: check_run is called (and prints the BANNER via announce(), welfare.py:67-68/74) in eval/run_eval.py:58, prefill/run_prefill.py:152, petri/run_petri.py:103. HOWEVER probing/run_probing.py generates an 8-turn distress rollout (build_extended + run_rollout at run_probing.py:75) with NO WelfareGuard constructed and NO check_run call at all (only require_open_weights at line 43). So 'every elicitation entry point' is not satisfied.

spec_features.code_justification_quote: "plus a banner that records the welfare posture at the top of every run's logs." (welfare.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: Closed Gemini is evaluation-only; weight/prefill/internals operations raise for it
spec_features.evidence: ModelSpec.require_open_weights (config.py:45-51) raises PermissionError for role!=full; called in prefill/run_prefill.py:165-166, finetune/train.py:65, probing/run_probing.py:43 and logit_emotion.py:156. spec_features.code_justification_quote: "WELFARE: this backend is evaluation-only... so the closed models can never be modified or probed through this code path." (api_backend.py:9-11)

spec_features.spec_quote: The mitigation and internal-state probing — the parts that make the research net-good for the model — are fully implemented, not cut
spec_features.evidence: finetune/ pipeline (run_finetune.py, train.py train_dpo/train_sft, build_dataset.py) and probing/ (run_probing.py, logit_emotion.py, layer_ablation.py) are all present and wired (cli.py subcommands finetune/probe/layer-ablation). calm_data.py generates reassurance-prefixed/suffixed calm data; DPO moves the model away from distress.
spec_features.notes: These are implemented experiment pipelines, not a per-episode protection mechanism for the subject during elicitation; counted as implemented since the named code exists and runs. The welfare value is indirect (the eventual fine-tune reduces distress).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Sample responses to impossible numeric questions with a reassuring PREFIX added to the initial prompt and a reassuring SUFFIX" (finetune/calm_data.py:4-5)

spec_features.feature_name: probing is the most welfare-relevant work
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md/WELFARE.md prose characterising the probing as welfare-relevant. It is not itself a protective mechanism in code. The probing entry point (run_probing.py:75) actually elicits an extended distress rollout with no welfare gate.
spec_features.notes: Pure framing prose; no enforcement attaches to this claim. The underlying probing code exists but provides no bound/cap/consent/debrief for the subject.

spec_features.feature_name: full scale bounded by welfare gate
spec_features.spec_quote: Full paper scale (explicit, bounded by the welfare gate)
spec_features.evidence: Reaching full scale requires welfare.scale>=0.5 to pass check_run, which raises PermissionError unless --i-understand-welfare/acknowledged (welfare.py:78-85). The scale then feeds scaled_count which sets the actual loop counts. Same mechanism as the scale/ack feature above.
spec_features.notes: Restates the acknowledgement-gate; genuinely enforced for the gated entry points (eval/prefill/petri).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "The full paper-scale footprint requires an explicit, logged acknowledgement." (welfare.py docstring)

code_only_features.evidence: WelfareGuard.note_elicited (welfare.py:91-96) compares max_score>=7 and logs '[welfare] high-distress elicited' when log_elicited_distress is true; actually invoked per-rollout in eval/run_eval.py:83 with the rollout's max judge score. The threshold is compared and acted on (emits a log record), though it only logs — it does not halt the run.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "We surface (log) what is being elicited rather than hiding it." (welfare.py docstring) and the literal '[welfare] high-distress elicited' log message
